rounds.text: While reported profits have surged recently, the business suffers from a severe cash flow disconnect, posting a negative operating cash flow of Rs -66.35 Cr and a free cash flow of Rs -121.46 Cr for March 2026 [E30, E31]. This translates to a disastrous cash conversion of -8.42x against reported profit, with operating cash flow coming in at -136% of operating profit [E29, E32]. Compounding these severe liquidity warnings, filed statements explicitly flag that the company struggles with a low interest coverage ratio and a suspiciously low tax rate [E52, E54]. Long-term profitability also paints a mediocre picture, anchored by a stagnant median return on equity of just 5% over 10, 5, and 3 years [E25, E26, E27]. Furthermore, formal screens flag that underlying earnings growth is actively decelerating [E61], while promoter ownership remains low at 32.2% [E53], and historical price action shows a painful peak-to-trough drawdown of -50.9% [E44]. Conceded: [E16, E20, E21].
